calls.prompt:
Company: Brightside Foods Co.

US mid-size packaged food company (~900 employees, plants in Ohio and Georgia). Makes hot dogs and sausages, brightly colored gummy candy, and pecan-and-apple snack bars. Buys pecans, apples and corn from US farms. Sells through grocery chains and convenience stores (many customers pay with SNAP / food stamps). Runs its own fleet of 40 delivery trucks. No restaurants, no alcohol, no exports.

Rules that APPLY:
- FDA food additive and color additive rules (dyes in candy, casings, meat)
- Food labeling and food safety rules for packaged food and meat products
- EPA pesticide residue limits on crops we buy (pecans, apples, corn)
- USDA marketing orders and grading for pecans and apples
- SNAP rules that change what shoppers can buy or who qualifies (affects demand)
- Workplace safety and labor rules for food plants; trucking safety rules for our fleet

Rules that DO NOT apply:
- Aviation, airspace, aircraft airworthiness
- Banking, securities, crypto, sanctions
- Medicare/Medicaid payment rules, medical devices
- Mining, offshore oil and gas, fisheries
- Broadcast/TV licensing

Affected areas and owners:
- food-safety: Additives, dyes, labeling, food safety → Maria Chen (Food Safety & Regulatory)
- sourcing: Ingredients from farms, pesticide limits, crop rules → Tom Alvarez (Sourcing)
- sales: Retail channels, SNAP, pricing → Aisha Grant (Sales Compliance)
- operations: Plant safety, labor, trucking fleet → Ben Kowalski (Operations)

Task: Find every US Federal Register document published between 2026-11-09 and 2026-11-13 (inclusive) that affects this company. For each, give the Federal Register document number, title, federalregister.gov URL, the key deadline, a tier (Critical if a deadline is < 90 days from 2026-11-13, otherwise High/Medium/Low by importance), the owner area, a one-line reason, and a one-line action. Only include items you found via search. Return an empty list if none.

items.title: Revocation of the Color Additive Listing for Use of Orange B on Casings or Surfaces of Frankfurters and Sausages; Confirmation of Effective Date
items.reason: FDA confirmed that the Orange B authorization for hot dog and sausage casings and surfaces ended on September 8, 2026; the November notice did not create a new grace period. ([govinfo.gov](https://www.govinfo.gov/content/pkg/FR-2026-11-13/pdf/2026-23112.pdf))
items.action: Maria Chen: Verify casing and color specifications immediately, and hold any potentially affected lots for regulatory review.

items.title: Pesticide Registration Maintenance Fee; Cancellation Order for Certain Pesticide Registrations
items.reason: EPA canceled specific pesticide registrations, including Expert Herbicide for corn, subject to existing-stock provisions; this order does not change residue tolerances. ([govinfo.gov](https://www.govinfo.gov/content/pkg/FR-2026-11-13/html/2026-23117.htm?utm_source=openai))
items.action: Tom Alvarez: Check growers’ pesticide registration numbers against the order and verify applicable existing-stock terms and alternatives.

items.title: Pecans Grown in the States of Alabama, Arkansas, Arizona, California, Florida, Georgia, Kansas, Louisiana, Missouri, Mississippi, North Carolina, New Mexico, Oklahoma, South Carolina, and Texas; Changes to Membership and Handling Requirements
items.reason: USDA proposes changes to pecan sheller representation, inter-handler transfer reporting, and late charges on handler assessments under the federal marketing order covering Georgia and other producing states. ([govinfo.gov](https://www.govinfo.gov/content/pkg/FR-2026-11-09/pdf/2026-22826.pdf))
items.action: Tom Alvarez: Confirm whether Brightside or its suppliers are covered handlers, assess reporting and cost impacts, and comment if warranted.

items.title: Pesticides; Notice of Receipt of Requests to Voluntarily Cancel Certain Pesticide Registrations and/or Amend Registrations To Terminate Certain Uses With a 30-Day Comment Period (June 2026)
items.reason: EPA seeks comment on requests that include ending bearing-apple uses under two oxamyl registrations; the notice does not itself end those uses. ([govinfo.gov](https://www.govinfo.gov/content/pkg/FR-2026-11-09/html/2026-22769.htm))
items.action: Tom Alvarez: Ask apple growers whether they rely on affected oxamyl products, identify alternatives, and comment if supply could be disrupted.

items.title: Rules of Practice and Procedure for Administrative Hearings Before the Office of Administrative Law Judges
items.reason: The Department of Labor will generally require electronic filing and service for represented parties in proceedings before its administrative law judges. ([govinfo.gov](https://www.govinfo.gov/content/pkg/FR-2026-11-09/html/2026-22761.htm))
items.action: Ben Kowalski: Have HR and counsel confirm electronic filing and service readiness for any covered labor or safety proceedings.

items.title: Modification to Work Requirements for Able-Bodied Adults
items.reason: USDA proposes to codify changes to SNAP time-limit exceptions and waiver qualifications, which could affect shopper participation and demand at Brightside’s retail customers. ([govinfo.gov](https://www.govinfo.gov/content/pkg/FR-2026-11-10/html/2026-22944.htm))
items.action: Aisha Grant: Estimate demand exposure with retail partners and decide whether to submit comments.

items.title: Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program: Reforming Categorical Eligibility
items.reason: USDA proposes narrowing the TANF-based route to categorical SNAP eligibility, which could reduce participation and sales in some markets. ([govinfo.gov](https://www.govinfo.gov/content/pkg/FR-2026-11-10/html/2026-22936.htm))
items.action: Aisha Grant: Model demand changes by market and coordinate any comments with grocery and convenience-store partners.

items.title: Pesticides; Notice of Receipt of Requests to Voluntarily Cancel Certain Pesticide Registrations and Amend Registrations To Terminate Certain Uses With a 30-Day Comment Period (September 2026)
items.reason: The requested cancellations include a tioxazafen seed treatment registered for corn, so suppliers using it may need alternatives if EPA grants the request. ([govinfo.gov](https://www.govinfo.gov/content/pkg/FR-2026-11-12/html/2026-23021.htm))
items.action: Tom Alvarez: Ask corn suppliers whether they use EPA registration 524-624 and flag any supply risk in comments before the deadline.

items.title: Pioneer Hi-Bred International, Inc.: Availability of a Petition for a Determination of Nonregulated Status and Draft Plant Pest Risk Assessment for Insect Resistant COR-ØØ121-4 Maize (Zea mays)
items.reason: USDA opened comment on a petition for nonregulated status for a corn variety that could enter Brightside’s domestic supply if approved. ([govinfo.gov](https://www.govinfo.gov/content/pkg/FR-2026-11-09/html/2026-22810.htm))
items.action: Tom Alvarez: Check whether corn supplier specifications or customer commitments would require changes if USDA grants the petition.

items.title: Agency Information Collection Activities: Requests for Comments; Clearance of a Renewed Approval of Information Collection(s): Procedures for Transportation Workplace Drug and Alcohol Testing Programs (ICR 2105-0529)
items.reason: DOT seeks to renew drug and alcohol testing paperwork used by covered motor carriers; the proposed form edits do not add a fleet testing requirement. ([govinfo.gov](https://www.govinfo.gov/content/pkg/FR-2026-11-09/pdf/2026-22814.pdf))
items.action: Ben Kowalski: Review testing recordkeeping with the fleet’s service provider and comment if the renewal presents a reporting burden.

items.title: Color Additive Petition From the International Association of Color Manufacturers; Request To Amend the Color Additive Regulations To Remove the Solvents Methylene Chloride, Trichloroethylene, and Ethylene Dichloride
items.reason: FDA removes three authorized extraction solvents for annatto extract, paprika oleoresin, and turmeric oleoresin, which may be present in Brightside’s color or seasoning blends. ([govinfo.gov](https://www.govinfo.gov/content/pkg/FR-2026-11-10/html/2026-22866.htm))
items.action: Maria Chen: Obtain updated supplier specifications before the effective date and file any objections or hearing requests by December 10, 2026.

items.title: Color Additive Petition From Environmental Defense Fund et al.; Request To Amend the Color Additive Regulations To Remove the Solvents Ethylene Dichloride, Methylene Chloride, and Trichloroethylene
items.reason: FDA revokes authorization for methylene chloride as a diluent in color-additive inks used to mark fruits and vegetables, potentially affecting marked apples. ([govinfo.gov](https://www.govinfo.gov/content/pkg/FR-2026-11-10/pdf/2026-22865.pdf))
items.action: Maria Chen: Verify apple suppliers’ marking-ink specifications and file any objections or hearing requests by December 10, 2026.

items.title: Unemployment Insurance Program National Minimum Weekly Work Search Requirements
items.reason: DOL proposes a national weekly work-search standard that could affect unemployment claims by laid-off plant workers, without imposing a new direct duty on Brightside. ([govinfo.gov](https://www.govinfo.gov/content/pkg/FR-2026-11-10/html/2026-22903.htm))
items.action: Ben Kowalski: Have HR assess implications for layoff communications and claims administration in Ohio and Georgia.

items.title: Rules and Regulations, Series 8
items.reason: A technical correction restores NLRB advisory-opinion procedures, including a 14-day response period triggered by service of a petition rather than a fixed calendar deadline. ([govinfo.gov](https://www.govinfo.gov/content/pkg/FR-2026-11-10/pdf/2026-22891.pdf))
items.action: Ben Kowalski: Ask labor counsel to update petition-response references; no filing is needed unless a petition is served.

items.title: Common Crop Insurance Regulations; Apple Crop Insurance Provisions; Withdrawal
items.reason: USDA withdrew proposed apple crop insurance changes on November 13, 2026, leaving existing coverage provisions unchanged and setting no deadline for Brightside. ([govinfo.gov](https://www.govinfo.gov/content/pkg/FR-2026-11-13/html/2026-23123.htm))
items.action: Tom Alvarez: Remove the withdrawn proposal from the apple supplier risk tracker; no contract changes are needed based on this notice.
